_about: AUTHORED data: the proposed caption per coop mission tile (title = the level's name, baked into the card; the round-1 'kicker' line was dropped in round 2 - the mission header names the mission - and survives here only as data). src tags: retail-ws = the BSP worldspawn 'message'; retail-save = a checkpoint name in global/savenames.scr; retail-brief = the briefing BSP's worldspawn; retail-region = no message in the briefing BSP, region from the campaign's level worldspawns; mod = coop_mod/variables.scr coop_mapDescription; authored = no retail name exists. Everything else in the inventory is SWEPT by inventory.py, not typed here.
_rules: The retail worldspawn name wins. Retail 'Chapter - Part' names: the part is the title (the chapter is the mission header). No place, operation, date or unit appears that the game files do not name.

_missions_format: 'proposed' is the NAME only; the prefix (e.g. 'AA 5 ', 'BT 2 ', or today's 'Allied Assault: 5 ') is the menu's layout choice. Names match the menu-system remaster's chalk list (station_layouts.py COOPOPS) exactly.
_sh_rule: SH levels: worldspawn is only the region, so the title is one of the level's retail checkpoint names (global/savenames.scr, mainta/pak1.pk3). RULE (a stated judgement, justified per level below): the checkpoint that names the level's central fight or goal as its RETAIL objectives describe it (retail maps/<bsp>.scr, read from the paks - the mod's objective strings are not used); if no checkpoint names it, the opening checkpoint.
